scope: this knight sample at 128x128 native cells
observations: The closed greathelm, visor and brass ridge remain readable in all 18 poses.

Outlined stepped contours and broad highlight clusters remain legible at native size and integer enlargement.
The six-pose walk changes the contacting foot; attack has overhead anticipation, swing and recovery; block raises and holds the shield.
limitations: Projected region coverage does not establish generated semantic limb lengths.
